title: Trigoku Daily Lock with Isla

segments.text: Trigoku Daily Lock today. Isla checks what sort of trouble it is first.

Then the day starts tugging at her sleeve again.
She leaves one message unread. Three minutes will not ruin anything.

full_text:
Trigoku Daily Lock today. Isla checks what sort of trouble it is first.

She is at small kitchen table in warm morning light, already half-thinking about the next job.

Then the day starts tugging at her sleeve again.

She leaves one message unread. Three minutes will not ruin anything.

Check the constraint before rushing.

The move holds, which is annoyingly satisfying.

She shuts the laptop before the rush gets the last word.
